$comment: TraceNode call-tree shapes for the tree-walk bound (ai.narrativetrace.core.tree.TreeWalk): a legitimate deep recursive method and a hand-built cyclic child list. `TreeWalk.MAX_DEPTH` itself (10,000) is exercised directly against the walker in TreeWalkTest, not replayed through every renderer here - several renderers indent proportionally to depth, so a chain that deep would make output size, not the bound, the thing under test. See README.md.

cases.description: a two-hundred-node call chain - a legitimate deep recursive method, must render in full, not crash; kept well under Oracles.MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES, since several renderers indent proportionally to depth
a node whose own children list holds itself
a hand-built tree whose child list contains an ancestor - undefended TraceNode.children
a ring long enough that a naive walk would need to fully traverse it before ever repeating
